content: Research on mem0 conflict resolution: their LLM-resolver maps to four ops — ADD / UPDATE / DELETE / NOOP. Source: https://docs.mem0.ai/conflict-resolution. Key takeaway: keeping conflict resolution in the LLM (not pre-computed rules) trades determinism for adaptability. Engram should consider this for v0.2 conflict detection. Tags: mem0, conflict-resolution, llm, memory.

expected.title: mem0 conflict resolution
expected.summary: mem0's LLM-resolver maps to four ops — ADD / UPDATE / DELETE / NOOP. Keeping conflict resolution in the LLM trades determinism for adaptability.

content: Letta (formerly MemGPT) — self-edit memory mode. Title: Letta self-edit. URL: https://letta.com/blog/self-editing-memory. Summary: agents can call tools that rewrite their own memory blocks via patch operations. Risk: ungated self-edit becomes hallucination amplifier; Letta gates with a separate 'archival memory' tier. Engram should NOT adopt before v0.3 reflect ships. Tags: letta, memgpt, self-edit, agent-memory.

content: Quick read on Vectorize namespaces (Cloudflare). Title: Vectorize namespaces tenant isolation. From https://developers.cloudflare.com/vectorize/best-practices/namespaces/. Key fact — one global index with namespace per workspace beats one-index-per-workspace because of the 100-index-per-account cap. Engram v0.1 must follow this. Tags: cloudflare, vectorize, namespaces, multi-tenant.

content: Read this on the train — Anthropic's prompt-cache 5-minute TTL. Title: Claude API prompt cache TTL. Source: https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/build-with-claude/prompt-caching#cache-lifetime. Summary: cache TTL is 5 minutes from last read; reads refresh it; expired blocks recompute on next request. Implication for Claude Code: keep wakeup intervals under 270s to stay in cache. Tags: anthropic, claude, prompt-cache, ttl, claude-code.

content: Title: Durable Objects SQLite migration footgun. Topic: Cloudflare DO storage. Source: https://developers.cloudflare.com/durable-objects/best-practices/migrations/. Summary: Once a DO class lands under new_sqlite_classes it CANNOT be moved back to new_classes — declaration is irreversible. Confirms Engram FND-08 CI lint rule. Tags: cloudflare, durable-objects, sqlite, migrations, irreversible.

expected.title: Durable Objects SQLite migration footgun
expected.summary: Once a DO class lands under new_sqlite_classes it cannot be moved back to new_classes — declaration is irreversible. Confirms Engram FND-08 CI lint rule.
